story: That biting, aggressive fuzz solo (famously played by McCartney, not Harrison) rides a pushed Vox AC30 with a tight low end so the midrange bite cuts through. We approximate it with VOX_TOPBOOST driven harder than the clean-era presets, plus the fuzz pedal in the signal path ahead of the amp. Listen for the fuzz staying tight and midrange-forward rather than washing out into a fat, bass-heavy blur.
